abstract: Looking at each measure, the groups differ in these ways. Overall, Brostamide and Standard care reach about the same systolic drop. Overall, Brostamide and Standard care reach about the same blood pressure control. Overall, Cardivel improves systolic drop compared with Standard care. Overall, Cardivel improves blood pressure control compared with Standard care.
conclusion: To sum up, the comparison of the groups shows the following. Overall, Brostamide and Standard care reach about the same systolic drop. Overall, Brostamide and Standard care reach about the same blood pressure control. Overall, Cardivel improves systolic drop compared with Standard care. Overall, Cardivel improves blood pressure control compared with Standard care.
section:
### Additional comparison

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Brostamide is a water tablet that helps the body clear extra salt. Cardivel is a tablet that slows the heart so it pushes with less force. All data for this comparison were collected at the Harbor Street Patients.
